title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Hide pages in published dashboards**: Dashboard authors can now hide a page so that it doesn't appear when the dashboard is published, while keeping it in the dashboard for authors. See [Hide a page in published dashboards](/aws/en/dashboards/manage#hide-page).
* **Path maps**: You can now use the path map visualization to show routes and connections between locations on a map. See [Map visualizations](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/maps).
* **Table column header alignment**: You can now set left, center, or right alignment for table column headers, independent of the cell alignment. See [Field-level settings](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/tables#field-level-settings).
